flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/System/{list/SuspensionReasonList,form/SuspensionReasonForm}.tsx + App.tsx route /system/suspension-reason + utils/constant.ts (SUSPENSION_TYPE); ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/suspensionreason/{SuspensionReason,SuspensionReasonController,SuspensionReasonServiceImpl} (+OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor, OCMS_SYSTEM_SUSPENSION_REASON), crud/ocmsizdb/standardcode/StandardCodeController, workflows/notice_creation/core/helpers/{PermanentSuspensionHelper,PermanentRevivalHelper,SuspensionBaseHelper,RevivalBaseHelper}; ocmsadminprivateapi utilities/suspension_helpers/{PermanentSuspensionHelper,SuspensionBaseHelper}. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not used
note: Story status: Fully paid. Requirement text is given. Sibling of OCMS39.10 (type TS); this story is for Permanent Suspension (PS) and revival. The officer uses the Suspension Reason page (list, create, edit) to add PS codes and revival codes (type RV) and to change the description and Active/Defunct status, with authorization checked on the server (OCMS_SYSTEM_SUSPENSION_REASON). When PS is applied the code is accepted only if an Active row exists for the calling source, so a new PS code works without a deploy. Gaps: the revival list for source PLUS is hardcoded (CSR, OTH); the allowed stages per PS code are hardcoded; the lists of PS codes that trigger a refund, come from payment, and stop payment are read from Standard Code, whose categories cannot be created from the UI and have no seed (fail-open for the payment stop when empty). DB rows and the roles holding the function: cannot verify from repo. The tickets read (OCMS-DF-2026-097, OCMS-DF-2026-173) do not change the assessment.
recommendation: Claim: maintenance of PS suspension codes, revival codes, reasons and status works and is used at once by the PS and revival logic. Tell URA: PLUS revival is only CSR and OTH (hardcoded), stages per PS code are hardcoded, and the Standard Code categories PS_REFUND_CODES/CRS_PS_CODES/PS_DISABLE_PAYMENT need rows in the DB (no seed in the repo)

steps.step: Officer opens the Suspension Reason page and sees the list of Permanent Suspension (PS) suspension codes and revival codes
steps.detail: Route /system/suspension-reason (App.tsx:452-474) calls POST /suspensionreasonlist (SuspensionReasonList.tsx:66-79, SuspensionReasonController.java:117-127) and shows rows of type TS, PS and RV with code, source, description and status; the form filters are passed as parameters so the officer can narrow to type PS or RV. Authorization function OCMS_SYSTEM_SUSPENSION_REASON (api-authorization.properties:172-174) is checked on the server by OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor (OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor.java:57-74). Roles holding the function and the PS/RV rows in the DB: cannot verify from repo (no SQL seed).

steps.step: Officer adds a new PS suspension code together with its reason
steps.detail: The create form sends POST /suspensionreason (SuspensionReasonForm.tsx:68-82) with suspensionType PS (fixed constant TS/PS/RV, constant.ts:199-203), suspensionSource, reasonOfSuspension (3 characters), description and status (SuspensionReasonForm.tsx:125-217; entity SuspensionReason.java:25-53). For type PS the revival period field is hidden (SuspensionReasonForm.tsx:229-239) because PS has no validity period. Duplicates are checked through POST /suspensionreasonexists (SuspensionReasonController.java:56-83); POST /suspensionreason itself saves directly (SuspensionReasonController.java:85-115). A new PS code can be used without a deploy (see step 5).

steps.step: Officer adds a new revival code together with its reason
steps.detail: Selecting type RV changes the form labels to Revival Source and Revival Code (SuspensionReasonForm.tsx:121, 157-160, 187-190), then it is saved through the same POST /suspensionreason (SuspensionReasonController.java:85-115). A revival code is stored as a row of type RV in ocms_suspension_reason, not in a separate table. Same as the revival step in OCMS39.10.

steps.step: Officer changes the description or the status (Active/Defunct) of a PS or revival code
steps.detail: Edit calls POST /suspensionreasonpatch/{type}/{code}/{source} (SuspensionReasonForm.tsx:84-100). The controller only accepts description, noOfDaysForRevival and status (PATCH_ALLOWED_FIELDS, SuspensionReasonController.java:129-190); type, code and source are locked in the form (SuspensionReasonForm.tsx:215). Active/Defunct is a toggle (SuspensionReasonForm.tsx:241-258). There is no delete endpoint; deactivating means status Defunct.

steps.step: When PS is applied to a notice, the code is accepted only if it is Active for the calling source
steps.detail: processPS calls checkSourcePermissionPS (PermanentSuspensionHelper.java:100-103, 170-175), which queries ocms_suspension_reason by suspensionType PS, reasonOfSuspension, suspensionSource and status 'A' (SuspensionBaseHelper.java:294-312); if no row exists the request is rejected with 'Source not authorized to use this Suspension Code' (SuspensionBaseHelper.java:323-336). A query error counts as not allowed (fail-closed). The cron/PLUS path in ocmsadminprivateapi uses the same check (PermanentSuspensionHelper.java:136-139; SuspensionBaseHelper.java:253-293). So a new PS code can be used at once and a Defunct code is rejected without a deploy. Same as the TS step in OCMS39.10.

steps.step: When a PS is revived, the revival code is validated against the configured list
steps.detail: PS revival calls validateRevivalCodeForSource (PermanentRevivalHelper.java:132-135). For the OCMS staff source the revival code must exist in ocms_suspension_reason with status A, source OCMS and type RV (RevivalBaseHelper.java:84-97, 177-183; SuspensionReasonServiceImpl.java:20-22), so a new revival code is valid at once. For the PLUS source, however, the list is hardcoded to CSR and OTH only (PLUS_ALLOWED_REVIVAL_CODES, RevivalBaseHelper.java:74-80, 166-172) and ignores the configuration; if the revival source is empty the validation is skipped (RevivalBaseHelper.java:160-164). Same fit as the revival step in OCMS39.10. The PermanentRevivalHelper copy in ocmsadminprivateapi has no caller (grep over src/main/java), so it is not counted.

steps.step: The behaviour of each PS code (allowed stages, refund, payment stop) follows the configuration
steps.detail: Configured: the PS codes allowed on paid notices that trigger a refund (PS_REFUND_CODES), the PS codes created by payment (CRS_PS_CODES) and the PS codes that stop payment (PS_DISABLE_PAYMENT) are read from ocms_standard_code (SuspensionBaseHelper.java:121-142) and used when PS is applied (PermanentSuspensionHelper.java:180-190; payment_acceptance_allowed='N' on VON at SuspensionBaseHelper.java:350-356 and on eVON at :404-409). Still hardcoded: the allowed stages per PS code (ANS, CAN, DIP/MID, RIP/RP2/SCT/SLC, etc.; SuspensionBaseHelper.java:81-98, 189-278). There is a catch: those Standard Code categories cannot be created from the UI (the Reference Code dropdown only lists categories that already exist, StandardCodeController.java:176-204) and the repo has no seed. On a fresh environment getPsRefundCodes can be empty, so PS-APP/CAN/CFA/VST on paid notices are rejected, and an empty getPsCodesDisablePayment means PS codes that should stop payment do not stop it (fail-open for payment). The real rows: cannot verify from repo. Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-097 and OCMS-DF-2026-173 (Closed, wrong payment_acceptance_allowed for PS-ANS/PS-APP via the CPS path) were read; neither changes the fit because they concern the CPS path, not code configuration.
